title: Lowpoly Select Window Options Parity
description: Lowpoly should have the same select window options as puzzle 3d: rectangle/lasso method toggles, selective/additive/subtractive/invertive merge-mode toggles, and selectable kind toggles (mesh/face/edge/vertex), as an always-visible Select window-options group wired through selectionMergeMode.
summary: Gave lowpoly the same always-visible Select window options as puzzle 3d: rectangle/lasso method toggles, selective/additive/subtractive/invertive merge modes, and mesh/face/edge/vertex kind toggles. Wired selection_mode_default through setSelectionModeDefault and selectionMergeMode in world selection JSON. Verified with cargo test -p lowpoly-plugin --lib (20 passed).
